method_note: Counted the 18 regular technical (oral) sessions of iSpaRo 2025 (Sendai, 1-4 Dec 2025) in the IEEE RAS PaperCept program (ICRS25); keynotes and the 4 half-day workshops (WS1-WS4) excluded. Each session = 1 unit, split across at most 2 keywords using session titles plus paper titles. 101 papers in 17 sessions plus at least 4 in C-6, whose full count was not captured (so the paper count for that track is null). The joint i-SAIRAS/iSpaRo 2026 edition (Cologne, 3-6 Nov 2026) has not yet taken place. deployable-structures added 2026-10-16: session A-2 'In-Space Manufacturing, Assembly, and Deployment', previously 1 unit of osam, names deployment in its title and has 2 of 6 papers on solar/antenna array folding and deployable mechanisms, so it was split 50/50 osam/deployable-structures (0.5/18 = 0.028; osam 0.083 -> 0.055). Single deployable-related papers in other sessions (solar sail attitude control via control boom, inflatable robotic arm IDRA, origami-based covers for rovers) were not counted.
